editorial.marketOverview: Friday November 20 is the latest US cash session. Reuters reported Nasdaq Composite -5.28%, SOX approximately -11%, and 10Y Treasury 4.93%; secondary reporting placed QQQ at -5.67%, while Barron's reported VIX 37.66. These are carried Friday observations, not Saturday quotes. Chip underperformance and risk reduction continue to dominate.
editorial.whatChanged: Since the prior 20:49 EST assessment, a fresh check of Reuters, AP, market commentary and the November 23–27 TD Economics calendar has not established any new material catalyst or realized US market response. The curated Open Watch repository remains unchanged at 174 events, last updated November 21 00:44:37 UTC. Friday's NVDA SEC probe report and Taiwan's Monday short-sale restriction were already incorporated.
editorial.marketInterpretation: Semiconductor relative weakness, widespread selling and elevated volatility keep near-term downside risk elevated despite potential sharp oversold rebounds. Friday's reported 10Y 4.93% cannot be paired with a non-synchronous 2Y 4.65% to claim a live curve. Older 4.94% minus 4.65% equals 29 basis points, only stale indicative. No primary time-aligned FedWatch probability, VXN, breadth or matched Brent/WTI contracts was verified. Expected catalyst impact must not be presented as an observed price reaction.
editorial.threeDayPath: Monday November 23: flash US manufacturing/services PMIs at 09:45 ET, Fed Williams 16:00 ET, HPE/Zoom/Agilent earnings; test whether SOX and QQQ stabilize. Tuesday November 24: consumer confidence 10:00 ET and ADI/Dell/Autodesk results; focus on chip guidance and breadth. Wednesday November 25: PCE/income, Q3 GDP, durable goods and claims at 08:30 ET, Beige Book 14:00 ET; macro surprise could reprice rates and volatility. All outcomes remain pending.
editorial.bullCase: A short-covering rebound could develop after severe Friday losses if QQQ, SOX and SMH recover together, advance/decline participation broadens, and VXN/VIX fall; falling synchronized yields would further support duration-sensitive tech. These confirmations are not yet observed.
editorial.bearCase: Renewed NVDA/SOX underperformance, negative breadth, elevated volatility, hawkish Fed repricing or adverse SEC/issuer disclosures would extend the drawdown. Potential yen carry unwind and Taiwan restrictions are risk scenarios, not verified Monday US responses.
editorial.watchNext: Verify Monday timestamp-aligned QQQ/Nasdaq/SOX/SMH, VXN/VIX, breadth, primary 10Y and 2Y Treasury yields, CME FedWatch, and same-maturity Brent/WTI. Monitor SEC/NVDA primary disclosures and new curated Open Watch events; compare price action to expectations rather than assuming impact.
